name: EXM_CC_DOWNLOAD_PARAMS
description: This table contains the parameters used to automatically download corporate card transaction files from a card issuer's server.

columns.name: CC_DOWNLOAD_PARAM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the download parameter set.

columns.name: DOWNLOAD_PROFILE_NAME
columns.description: Name that identifies a set of download parameters.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program for which download parameters are defined.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the company account for which download parameters are defined.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CP_DEFAULTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether to use company account-specific download parameters.

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: Deploying company's account name with card issuer for connecting to the card issuer's server.

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_PASSWORD
columns.description: Deploying company's account password for card issuer stored encrypted.

columns.name: REMOTE_FILENAME
columns.description: Partial name of the feed file from the card issuer.

columns.name: SERVER
columns.description: Corporate card issuer's server from which the application downloads the feed file.

columns.name: SECURE_DIRECTORY
columns.description: Deploying company's directory where the feed file is stored.

columns.name: PGP_ENCRYPTION_ALIAS
columns.description: An alternative name used to identify the Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) encryption key for a corporate card transaction file.

columns.name: PGP_SIGNATURE_ALIAS
columns.description: An alternate name used to identify a bank's Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) signature key for a corporate card transaction file.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
